from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0018 (pose: 0.183, 1.183, heading 60):
# Cabinet is in the middle. Let find bottom y of cabinet in obs_0018:
arr18 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0018.png"))
# cabinet front panel color: [154, 147, 132] or [137, 118, 93]
cab_m = (arr18[:, :, 0] > 130) & (arr18[:, :, 0] < 165) & (arr18[:, :, 1] > 110) & (arr18[:, :, 1] < 155) & (arr18[:, :, 2] > 90) & (arr18[:, :, 2] < 140)
# restrict to x in [180, 270]
y_cab, x_cab = np.where(cab_m & (np.arange(512)[None, :] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 270))
print(f"Cabinet in obs_0018: bottom_y = {y_cab.max()}, cx = {x_cab.mean():.1f}")
D_cab = 256 * 1.55 / (y_cab.max() - 255.5)
print(f"Cabinet distance D = {D_cab:.3f}")
# In pose 18 (heading 60):
# heading direction = [sin(60), cos(60)] = [0.866, 0.5]
# offset angle = atan((x_cab.mean() - 255.5) / 256)
alpha = np.arctan((x_cab.mean() - 255.5) / 256)
th = np.radians(60) + alpha
x_cab_pos = 0.183 + D_cab * np.sin(th)
y_cab_pos = 1.183 + D_cab * np.cos(th)
print(f"Cabinet position: x = {x_cab_pos:.3f}, y = {y_cab_pos:.3f}")
'
